GET /api/lab-report-shares/open/:token.note: Opens only for the named account, signed in: the claim is bound to grantee_user_id, revoked_at, the open limit and expiry. The owner, another founder, an admin, an unstored or broken token get the one 404 and no open is counted; no credentials or a disabled grantee get 401.

POST /api/lab-report-shares/:id/revoke.note: Only the report's owner revokes (owner_user_id = caller): another founder, the named reader and an admin get the one 404 and nothing changes; no credentials get 401.
